snippet.title: Pizzapoly – Official Gameplay Trailer | 4-Player Co-op Pizza Restaurant Simulator
snippet.description:
Run your own pizza restaurant with up to 4 players in Pizzapoly, a chaotic online co-op restaurant simulator!

Prepare pizzas from scratch, manage incoming orders, serve hungry customers, hop on your scooter for deliveries, and upgrade your restaurant as your business grows.

Can you and your friends handle the pizza rush?

🍕 **WISHLIST PIZZAPOLY ON STEAM:**
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4414500/Pizzapoly/

**PLAY THE DEMO ON STEAM:**
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5363200/

**GAME FEATURES:**
- 1–4 player online co-op
- Prepare and bake pizzas step by step
- Serve customers and manage online orders
- Explore the neighborhood and deliver pizzas
- Upgrade your restaurant and grow your business
- Survive the chaos with your friends!

Developed by Polytan Game Studio.

Website: https://polytan.games
Discord: https://discord.gg/pizzapoly

#Pizzapoly #CoopGames #SimulationGames #IndieGames #SteamGames
